root_causes.cause: Non-tensor-core execution limits math throughput for GEMM on MI300X.

evidence.interpretation: No tensor/XDLOPS pipeline activity, so matrix math runs on less efficient VALU path.

fixes.fix: Refactor kernel/autotune configs to use MFMA/XDLOPS-compatible tile shapes and Triton AMD matrix-core codegen path (for fp16/bf16) so tl.dot lowers to tensor instructions.
fixes.rationale: Enabling matrix cores typically raises compute utilization substantially for GEMM and shifts kernel closer to roofline.

root_causes.cause: On-chip data movement inefficiency (LDS conflicts) likely introduces stall overhead despite full wave occupancy.

evidence.interpretation: Significant LDS bank conflicts indicate shared-memory access serialization, reducing effective throughput.

fixes.fix: Retune BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N/BLOCK_K and LDS layout (padding/swizzled shared-memory indexing) to reduce bank conflicts in A/B tile staging.
fixes.rationale: Lower LDS conflicts reduces pipeline stalls and improves both compute issue efficiency and memory-feed regularity.
